consent.title: AI generation and personal data
consent.explanation: Choose which enabled AI providers may process your profile and the job ad to create cover letters and tailored CVs. Your choice is saved, and you will not be asked again while the consent remains valid for the current notice. Job search and your profile work if you decline. You can withdraw consent here at any time. Withdrawal stops new calls but cannot recall data already sent. Contact us for erasure at the recipient.

consent.unavailable: This provider has not been enabled with reviewed information.
consent.changed: The notice has changed or the provider is disabled. Previous consent does not allow new calls.

consent.careerScope: Optional: select up to three career entries. Only type, title, organization, dates and skills are sent with your profile. Descriptions and other narrative career fields are not sent.
consent.emailNote: The message is sent only when you send it in your email application. Avoid sensitive information.

support.title: Support
support.subtitle: Need help? We're here for you.
support.cardFaqDesc: Find answers to the most common questions about Aplifyr.
support.cardContactDesc: Send us a message and we'll reply within 24 hours.
support.faq1a: Aplifyr analyses your profile and compares it against job listings to give you a grade (A, B or C) based on how well you match.
support.faq2q: How do I add a new job?
support.faq2a: Go to the All Jobs page and use the upload feature to add a job listing manually or via a link.
support.faq3q: Can I change the app language?
support.faq3a: Yes! Click the language switcher (EN/SV) at the bottom of the sidebar to toggle between English and Swedish.
support.faq4q: How do I remove a job from the list?
support.faq4a: Open the job and select Remove. The job will be deleted from your list immediately.
support.formSuccessDesc: We'll get back to you within 24 hours.
support.unavailable: The contact form is not connected yet. Messages cannot be sent here.
